paper_metadata.title: Quantum-Assisted AI for Speeding up Large-Scale Data Processing

experiments.description: Hybrid quantum-classical QAAI framework evaluated on healthcare, finance, and cybersecurity datasets using QSVM, QNN, VQC, and randomized measurement protocols; includes real-time data processing and scalability testing.

algorithm.variant: Quantum-Assisted Artificial Intelligence (QAAI) framework combining QSVM, QNN, variational quantum circuits, and randomized measurement protocols

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Classical data were encoded into quantum states using basis encoding for patient records/diagnostic data and amplitude encoding for stock market trends and real-time trading patterns; randomized measurement protocols were used for noisy/high-dimensional data.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Improve classification, prediction, clustering, and anomaly detection performance while reducing training time and improving noise resilience in large-scale data processing.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Hybrid quantum-classical pipeline; randomized measurement protocols for noise resilience; classical preprocessing/postprocessing offloads computationally intensive tasks to classical systems.

problem_instance.description: Multi-domain evaluation on healthcare diagnostic data, financial market trend/trading data, and cybersecurity network traffic/anomaly detection data; includes real-time and large-scale data streams.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Normalization, feature scaling, and data balancing; basis encoding for healthcare records; amplitude encoding for finance data; randomized measurement protocol for cybersecurity/noisy data.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score) measured across multiple iterations; scalability tested on large-scale data streams in real time; no explicit cross-validation or number of runs reported.
